name: Valley Farms LTD.-Desert Sweet Organic
description: Valley Farms LTD.-Desert Sweet Organic is a working apple orchard in Wilcox, AZ. It grows Apples and Cherries, with picking through autumn and summer. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Aug – Nov in this growing zone.
